title: A division that takes the program down
prompt: RATECALC.rpgle divides by a quantity that can be zero and by a rate read from a file, so the program ends with an unhandled exception and the job log is all the user gets. Handle it with a MONITOR group: on an error, set the result to zero and the error flag on. Do not add a *PSSR subroutine.
check: codeonly RATECALC.rpgle | grep -qi 'monitor;' && codeonly RATECALC.rpgle | grep -qi 'on-error' && codeonly RATECALC.rpgle | grep -qi 'endmon' && ! codeonly RATECALC.rpgle | grep -qi '\*pssr' && codeonly RATECALC.rpgle | grep -qi 'inError = \*on'
